expect.notes: Interactive stdin/stdout JSON loop over one long-lived exec with bufsize=1: stdin.write + drain, readline from p.stdout. stdout must contain the three lines in this order; the 1/0 case writes 'Execution Error: division by zero' to the SANDBOX stderr JSON field, which the script prints to its own stderr (assert on stderr, with ANSI red codes).

entries.why: Open stdin on exec + line-buffered streaming: the shape most agent code-interpreters use.

expect.notes: Image debian_slim(3.12).uv_pip_install('jupyter~=1.1.0'), Sandbox.create with an entrypoint command, encrypted_ports=[8888], secrets=[Secret.from_dict(...)] (env JUPYTER_TOKEN), then tunnels()[8888].url polled from the JOB over https until /api/status says started. 'Timed out waiting' must be absent. Script never terminates the sandbox: runner deletes it (it has timeout=5min).

entries.why: Tunnels/encrypted ports + secrets-as-env + entrypoint command: the web-app-in-a-sandbox pattern (same as E2B get_host).

stdout_contains: Running 2 trials on 2 concurrent Modal Sandboxes
expect.notes: uv run --script (PEP 723 deps: harbor + modal per the file header) writes a trivial task (ubuntu:24.04, answer.txt must equal 'ok'), then shells out to `harbor run --agent oracle --env modal` with n-parallel 2. Harbor's own Modal environment creates 2 sandboxes from an ubuntu:24.04 registry image, uploads the task files, runs solve.sh and test.sh, reads reward. Assert both trials reward 1.0 (the summary line printed by harbor; confirm format at pin time) and exit 0. Needs MODAL_TOKEN_ID/SECRET env, which the gateway env supplies.

entries.why: RL/eval harness over parallel Modal Sandboxes (Harbor/Terminal-Bench): a parallel-sandbox rollout pattern.

entries.why: Multi-container Sandbox (experimental API): could be built on Cua multi-Space networking; otherwise native error from the experimental call.
